an6.65:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo anāgāmiphalaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an6.65:1.3: assaddhiyaṃ, ahirikaṃ, anottappaṃ, kosajjaṃ, muṭṭhasaccaṃ, duppaññataṃ.
an6.65:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo anāgāmiphalaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an6.65:2.1: cha bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo anāgāmiphalaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an6.65:2.3: assaddhiyaṃ, ahirikaṃ, anottappaṃ, kosajjaṃ, muṭṭhasaccaṃ, duppaññataṃ.
an6.65:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo anāgāmiphalaṃ sacchikātunti.
